greeting: Good morning, Dan — the calendar's empty and the day belongs to the road south. One reply and a couple of long-overdue bookings are the only things quietly asking for you.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Amin on the CIFIC search
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani wrote Oct 15 after your call — he's leading the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search at CIFIC and offered to take it further if you're interested. The reply is yours to send.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 board task to book a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has sat open since Sep 14. Holiday inventory sells out; a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by Sep 30 and book-by Oct 15 dates have both passed on this p2 board item — six people over three weeks of holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year.

schedule.title: Spark by Hilton, Fredericksburg
schedule.detail: Overnight stop on the drive south

flagged.title: Two recruiter pings on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: Terence Quek (board practice) and Hans-Kristian are both waiting on a reply.

flagged.title: New ZipRecruiter sign-in
flagged.detail: Your Google account signed in to ZipRecruiter at 3:40 AM — fine if that was you.

flagged.title: Apple receipts posted overnight
flagged.detail: Dashlane annual ($64.99) and NYT Games renewed.

flagged.title: Independent Managers Club call set
flagged.detail: Misaki proposed Nov 4, 7 AM EST; you're cc'd, Mike and Chie lead.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — WSJ, Airbnb, Netflix, a few shops.
inbox.clear: Inbox is otherwise quiet; nothing else awaits a reply.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans into the season's roots, squash, and slow-cooked warmth.

tasks.title: Drive the Pathfinder down to St Pete
Portland house order — bedframe + shower holder

acts.line: The calendar is empty — a travel day, with the road doing the work.
Open miles on I-95; nothing pulls at your attention but the drive.
You check in at the Spark by Hilton in Fredericksburg, roughly the halfway mark south.
